verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ’e·reṣ mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them After you enter . . . . . . the land that I am giving you as a home
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra das vossas habitações, que eu vos hei de dar,

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־ זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִן־ הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן־ הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh ’ōw- ze·ḇaḥ lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw ḇin·ḏā·ḇāh ’ōw bə·mō·‘ă·ḏê·ḵem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh min- hab·bā·qār ’ōw min- haṣ·ṣōn
verses.literal: and you present a food offering to the LORD from the herd or . . . flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD either a burnt offering or a sacrifice for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast
verses.literalPt: e fizerdes uma oferta queimada a Jeová, holocausto, ou sacrifício em cumprimento dum voto, ou como oferta voluntária, ou nas vossas festas fixas, para fazerdes um suave cheiro a Jeová, do gado ou do rebanho,

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ham·maq·rîḇ qā·rə·bā·nōw Yah·weh min·ḥāh sō·leṯ ‘iś·śā·rō·wn bā·lūl bir·ḇi·‘îṯ ha·hîn šā·men
verses.literal: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil
verses.literalPt: aquele que oferecer a sua oblação oferecerá a Jeová uma oferta de cereais da décima parte dum efa de flor de farinha, amassada com a quarta parte dum him de azeite;

verses.original: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֙סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל־ הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin lan·ne·seḵ rə·ḇî·‘îṯ ha·hîn ta·‘ă·śeh ‘al- hā·‘ō·lāh ’ōw laz·zā·ḇaḥ lak·ke·ḇeś hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering
verses.literalPt: e de vinho para a oferta de libação prepararás a quarta parte de um him com o holocausto ou para o sacrifício de cada cordeiro.

verses.original: א֤וֹ לָאַ֙יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw lā·’a·yil ta·‘ă·śeh min·ḥāh sō·leṯ šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men šə·li·šîṯ ha·hîn
verses.literal: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil
verses.literalPt: Para um carneiro, prepararás como oferta de cereais, duas décimas partes dum efa de flor de farinha, amassada com a terça parte dum him de azeite;

verses.original: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin lan·ne·seḵ šə·li·šîṯ ha·hîn taq·rîḇ rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: e como oferta de libação oferecerás a terceira parte dum him de vinho, em suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־ בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־ זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־ נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ־ שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḇen- bā·qār ‘ō·lāh ’ōw- zā·ḇaḥ lə·p̄al·lê- ne·ḏer ’ōw- šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quando preparares um novilho para holocausto, ou para sacrifício, em cumprimento dum voto, ou para ofertas pacíficas a Jeová,

verses.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־ בֶּן־ הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rîḇ ‘al- ben- hab·bā·qār min·ḥāh sō·leṯ šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm bā·lūl baš·še·men ḥă·ṣî ha·hîn
verses.literal: present with . . . the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil
verses.literalPt: com o novilho oferecerás uma oferta de cereais de três décimas partes dum efa de flor de farinha, amassada com meio him de azeite.

verses.original: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin taq·rîḇ lan·ne·seḵ ḥă·ṣî ha·hîn ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering It is a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Como a oferta de libação oferecerás meio him de vinho, para oferta queimada, em suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשּׁוֹר֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ־ לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ḵāh yê·‘ā·śeh laš·šō·wr hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ōw lā·’a·yil hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ōw- laś·śeh ḇak·kə·ḇā·śîm ’ōw ḇā·‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: This is to be done for each bull ram . . . . . . lamb . . . or goat
verses.literalPt: Assim se fará com cada novilho, ou cada carneiro, ou cada um dos cordeiros ou dos bodes.

verses.original: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kam·mis·pār ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śū kā·ḵāh ta·‘ă·śū lā·’e·ḥāḏ kə·mis·pā·rām
verses.literal: This is how you must prepare . . . each one . . . no matter how many
verses.literalPt: Assim o fareis com cada um, conforme o número que oferecerdes.

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־ כָּ֖כָה אֶת־ אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ez·rāḥ ya·‘ă·śeh- kā·ḵāh ’eṯ- ’êl·leh lə·haq·rîḇ ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Todos os naturais assim farão essas coisas, ao oferecerem uma oferta queimada, em suave cheiro a Jeová.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר א֤וֹ אֲשֶֽׁר־ בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ḡūr ’it·tə·ḵem gêr ’ōw ’ă·šer- bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem wə·‘ā·śāh ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śū kên ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: And for the generations to come if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD he is to do . . . exactly as you do
verses.literalPt: Se um estrangeiro peregrinar convosco ou quem quer que estiver entre vós nas vossas gerações e oferecer uma oferta queimada em suave cheiro a Jeová, como vós fizerdes, assim fará ele.

verses.original: הַקָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haq·qā·hāl ḥuq·qāh ’a·ḥaṯ lā·ḵem wə·lag·gêr hag·gār ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kā·ḵem kag·gêr yih·yeh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident . . . it is a permanent statute for the generations to come You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quanto à assembleia, haverá um só estatuto para vós e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar convosco, estatuto perpétuo nas vossas gerações; como vós sois, assim será o estrangeiro diante de Jeová.

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: tō·w·rāh ’a·ḥaṯ ū·miš·pāṭ ’e·ḥāḏ yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·lag·gêr hag·gār ’it·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you
verses.literalPt: Uma só lei e uma só ordenança haverá para vós e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar convosco.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem bə·ḇō·’ă·ḵem ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem šām·māh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them When you enter . . . . . . the land to which I am bringing you
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra na qual vos hei de introduzir,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה בַּאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ba·’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵem mil·le·ḥem hā·’ā·reṣ tā·rî·mū ṯə·rū·māh Yah·weh
verses.literal: and you eat the food of the land . . . you shall lift up an offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: acontecerá que, quando comerdes o pão da terra, fareis uma oferta alçada a Jeová.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·ṯê·ḵem ḥal·lāh tā·rî·mū ṯə·rū·māh kiṯ·rū·maṯ gō·ren kên tā·rî·mū ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: From the first of your dough you are to lift up a cake as a contribution offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor
verses.literalPt: Das primícias da vossa massa oferecereis um bolo como oferta alçada; como a oferta alçada da eira, assim o oferecereis.

verses.original: מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: mê·rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·ṯê·ḵem tit·tə·nū Yah·weh tə·rū·māh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Throughout your generations you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough
verses.literalPt: Das primícias da vossa massa fareis uma oferta alçada a Jeová, durante as vossas gerações.

verses.original: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯiš·gū wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ’êṯ kāl- ham·miṣ·wōṯ hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses
verses.literalPt: Quando errardes e não observardes todos estes mandamentos que Jeová tem falado a Moisés,

verses.original: אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן־ הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה וָהָ֖לְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ă·lê·ḵem bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh min- hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh wā·hā·lə·’āh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: all that the LORD . . . has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come
verses.literalPt: sim, tudo quanto Jeová vos ordenou por intermédio de Moisés, desde o dia em que Jeová começou a dar os seus mandamentos e daí em diante durante as vossas gerações,

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם מֵעֵינֵ֣י הָעֵדָה֮ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִשְׁגָגָה֒ וְעָשׂ֣וּ כָל־ הָעֵדָ֡ה פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָר֩ אֶחָ֨ד לְעֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָת֥וֹ וְנִסְכּ֖וֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im mê·‘ê·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh ne·‘eś·ṯāh liš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·‘ā·śū ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh par ben- bā·qār ’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·nis·kōw kam·miš·pāṭ ū·śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull . . . . . . as a burnt offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation and one male goat . . . as a sin offering
verses.literalPt: acontecerá que, se alguma coisa se fizer por ignorância, sem o conhecimento da congregação, toda a congregação oferecerá um novilho para holocausto, em suave cheiro a Jeová, juntamente com a sua oferta de cereais e com a sua oferta de libação, segundo a ordenança, e um bode para oferta pelo pecado.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַֽל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנִסְלַ֣ח לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ שְׁגָגָ֣ה הִ֔וא וְהֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ קָרְבָּנָ֜ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ שִׁגְגָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per hak·kō·hên ‘al- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nis·laḥ lā·hem kî- šə·ḡā·ḡāh hî wə·hêm hê·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nām ’iš·šeh Yah·weh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- šiḡ·ḡā·ṯām
verses.literal: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation . . . of Israel so that they may be forgiven for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD a food offering and a sin offering presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote fará expiação por toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e se lhes perdoará; pois foi erro, mas trouxeram a sua oblação, oferta queimada a Jeová, e a sua oferta pelo pecado perante a Jeová, por causa do seu erro.

verses.original: וְנִסְלַ֗ח לְכָל־ עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֥י לְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nis·laḥ lə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām kî lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām biš·ḡā·ḡāh
verses.literal: Then the whole congregation . . . of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven since it happened to all the people unintentionally
verses.literalPt: Perdoar-se-á a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel e ao estrangeiro que peregrina entre eles, porque todo o povo participa do que se fez por ignorância.

verses.original: וְאִם־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ אַחַ֖ת תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֛יבָה עֵ֥ז בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֖הּ לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ne·p̄eš ’a·ḥaṯ te·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·hiq·rî·ḇāh ‘êz baṯ- šə·nā·ṯāh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: Also, if one person sins unintentionally he is to present a year-old . . . female goat as a sin offering
verses.literalPt: Se alguma pessoa pecar por ignorância, oferecerá uma cabra dum ano como oferta pelo pecado.

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַל־ הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּחֶטְאָ֥ה בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per hak·kō·hên ‘al- han·ne·p̄eš haš·šō·ḡe·ḡeṯ bə·ḥeṭ·’āh ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally . . . and when atonement has been made for him he will be forgiven
verses.literalPt: O sacerdote fará expiação pela alma que erra, quando pecar por ignorância, diante de Jeová, para fazer expiação por ela, e se lhe perdoará.

verses.original: הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם תּוֹרָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם לָעֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ez·rāḥ biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām tō·w·rāh ’a·ḥaṯ yih·yeh lā·ḵem lā·‘ō·śeh biš·ḡā·ḡāh
verses.literal: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error whether he is a native-born Israelite . . . or a foreigner residing among you
verses.literalPt: Tereis uma só lei para aquele que fizer alguma coisa por ignorância, tanto para o natural entre os filhos de Israel como para o estrangeiro que peregrina entre eles.

verses.original: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה׀ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן־ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֔ר אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא מְגַדֵּ֑ף וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer- ta·‘ă·śeh bə·yāḏ rā·māh min- hā·’ez·rāḥ ū·min- hag·gêr ’eṯ- Yah·weh hū mə·ḡad·dêp̄ wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: But the person who sins defiantly . . . whether a native or foreigner blasphemes the LORD That person . . . shall be cut off from among his people
verses.literalPt: Mas a pessoa que fizer alguma coisa afoitamente, ou seja natural ou seja estrangeiro, ela blasfema a Jeová; tal pessoa será cortada dentre o seu povo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ בָּזָ֔ה וְאֶת־ מִצְוָת֖וֹ הֵפַ֑ר הִכָּרֵ֧ת׀ תִּכָּרֵ֛ת הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא עֲוֺנָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh bā·zāh wə·’eṯ- miṣ·wā·ṯōw hê·p̄ar hik·kā·rêṯ tik·kā·rêṯ han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w ‘ă·wō·nāh ḇāh
verses.literal: He . . . shall certainly be cut off . . . because he has despised the word of the LORD and broken His commandment his guilt remains on him
verses.literalPt: Pois ela desprezou a palavra de Jeová e violou o seu mandamento; essa pessoa, certamente, será cortada, e sobre ela estará a sua iniquidade.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אִ֛ישׁ מְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ עֵצִ֖ים בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bam·miḏ·bār way·yim·ṣə·’ū ’îš mə·qō·šêš ‘ê·ṣîm bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: While the Israelites . . . were in the wilderness a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: Estando os filhos de Israel no deserto, acharam um homem apanhando lenha no dia de sábado.

verses.original: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ אֹת֔וֹ הַמֹּצְאִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ מְקֹשֵׁ֣שׁ עֵצִ֑ים אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rî·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw ham·mō·ṣə·’îm ’ō·ṯōw mə·qō·šêš ‘ê·ṣîm ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Those who found the man gathering wood brought him to Moses . . . Aaron . . . and the whole congregation
verses.literalPt: Os que o acharam apanhando lenha trouxeram-no a Moisés, a Arão e a toda a congregação.

verses.original: וַיַּנִּ֥יחוּ אֹת֖וֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר כִּ֚י לֹ֣א פֹרַ֔שׁ מַה־ יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yan·nî·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw bam·miš·mār kî lō p̄ō·raš mah- yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: and because it had not been declared what should be done to him they placed him in custody
verses.literalPt: Meteram-no em prisão, porque ainda não estava declarado o que se lhe devia fazer.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָאִ֑ישׁ רָג֨וֹם אֹת֤וֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh mō·wṯ yū·maṯ hā·’îš rā·ḡō·wm ’ō·ṯōw ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses The man must surely be put to death . . . The whole congregation is to stone . . . him outside the camp
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Jeová a Moisés: O homem, certamente, será morto; toda a congregação o apedrejará fora do arraial.

verses.original: וַיֹּצִ֨יאוּ אֹת֜וֹ כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֗ה אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yir·gə·mū ’ō·ṯōw bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm way·yā·mōṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: So the whole congregation . . . took the man outside the camp and stoned him to death as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Toda a congregação o levou para fora do arraial e o apedrejou, e ele morreu, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־ כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־ צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem wə·‘ā·śū lā·hem ṣî·ṣiṯ ‘al- kan·p̄ê ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām wə·nā·ṯə·nū ‘al- ṣî·ṣiṯ hak·kā·nāp̄ pə·ṯîl tə·ḵê·leṯ
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments with a blue cord on each tassel . . .
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes que nos cantos dos seus vestidos se lhes façam fímbrias durante as suas gerações, e que se ponham na fímbria de cada canto um fio azul.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lā·ḵem lə·ṣî·ṣiṯ ū·rə·’î·ṯem ’ō·ṯōw ū·zə·ḵar·tem ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- ṯā·ṯu·rū ’a·ḥă·rê lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·’a·ḥă·rê ‘ê·nê·ḵem ’ă·šer- ’at·tem zō·nîm ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: These will serve as tassels for you to look at so that you may remember all the commandments of the LORD that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves . . . by following . . . your own heart . . . and your own eyes
verses.literalPt: Ser-vos-á por fímbria, para que, vendo-a, vos lembreis de todos os mandamentos de Jeová e os observeis, para que não vos deixeis arrastar à infidelidade pelo vosso coração e pelos vossos olhos;

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tiz·kə·rū wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāy wih·yî·ṯem qə·ḏō·šîm lê·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments and you will be holy to your God
verses.literalPt: para que vos lembreis de todos os meus mandamentos, e os observeis, e sejais santos para com o vosso Deus.

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lih·yō·wṯ lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus. Eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus.
